# proof.rootz.global — Agentic Message Security

Full machine-readable brief: https://proof.rootz.global/ai.md  (JSON: /ai.json)

## What this site is
Rootz makes the *messages* in an AI interaction provable — signed, verifiable, and durable —
at every hop. Not a perimeter around the AI ("AI in a box"), but cryptographic integrity on the
messages themselves: **agentic message security**. Two pillars, one primitive.

## Pillar 1 — Humans <-> AI: Proof of Origin
How a human talks to an AI securely and owns the result. The user signs the prompt at the
source; a measured model answers; the output is cryptographically bound to that prompt and
returned as a signed receipt (a data wallet) — a certificate of both authenticity and ownership.
Green light = verified & owned; check-engine = proof failed.
- Patent: US 2025/0112783 A1, "System to Assure a Response from an Identified, Measured and
  Verified AI." Filed 2024-09-27, allowed 2026-06-03. Inventors: Michael Sprague, Steven Sprague.
  https://patents.google.com/patent/US20250112783A1
- Live on-chain artifacts (birth certificate / session archive / test report):
  https://rootz.global/s/0x70b893e3b519255166a1fb64dcde920d056a2d5c?k=yTFRhjNRGsOGstZ--xQ9B6drM3tL3c6FZ6s0qomPa6o

## Pillar 2 — AI <-> Services: Signed MCP
How an AI talks to tools and services securely. DKIM for the Model Context Protocol: every MCP
response and tool/resource definition carries a portable signature proving origin, integrity, and
freshness independent of transport. Crypto-agile + hybrid post-quantum (ed25519, ecdsa-p256,
ml-dsa-65/FIPS 204), RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, keys via DNS selector + JWKS. Stops
tool-poisoning by signing the definitions the model reads.
- Explainer: https://proof.rootz.global/signed-mcp
- Live signed sample (GET): https://proof.rootz.global/sign-demo
- Verify any Rootz-signed response (POST {object, envelope}): https://proof.rootz.global/verify
- Public keys (JWKS): https://proof.rootz.global/.well-known/mcp-jwks.json
- Signature lives in result._meta["rootz.global/sig"].

## Why both pillars are the same idea
A human-to-AI prompt and an AI-to-service call are both messages between agents. One primitive —
signed, durable, verifiable messages — applied to both directions.
- Five Eyes "Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services" (2026-04-30):
  https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/careful-adoption-agentic-ai-services
- NSA MCP Security notice (U/OO/6030316-26):
  https://www.nsa.gov/Press-Room/Press-Releases-Statements/Press-Release-View/Article/4475134/
- Pope Leo XIV, Magnifica Humanitas (2026-05-15):
  https://www.vatican.va/content/leo-xiv/en/encyclicals/documents/20260515-magnifica-humanitas.html
